summary: Four of eight hypothalamus transcription factors could be identified uniquely in the published expression plot. Evx1, Foxa2, Tfap2c and Gata3 were lower in diestrus in both the figure and the registered output. Effect magnitudes differed, and four pairs fall below the 30-gene concordance minimum. The proposal and evidence passed offline replay.
openIssues: The figure has unlabeled points. Four selected genes remain unresolved, and the four recovered effects are approximate.
The reviewed public sources did not provide the full hypothalamus DEGSeq table or gene-wise expression P and FDR values. Genome-wide agreement remains unassessed.
